thesis: A repaired PSU bank trading below book for a real reason: the government must sell. Every engine gate passes — CAMEL 7/10 with CRAR 18.61% and GNPA 2.17% (down from 9%+ at the PCA exit), zero pledge, clean usability, no event vetoes. FY26 was the best year on record: PAT Rs 2,768 cr, cost-to-income improved 581 bps to 52.66%, and the bank beat its own FY26 guidance on nearly every line. At Rs 23.45 the price sits 7% under the engine's invest trigger Rs 25.20 and at 0.88x book. But this is a lower-quality version of the J&K Bank setup: RoE 8.3% barely covers the cost of equity, CAMEL efficiency legs score 1, and the 90.95%-to-75% dilution (270 cr new shares + possible OFS, SEBI deadline already being extended) will cap the price until the supply is absorbed. The anchor says buy the discount; the overhang says don't pay up for it.
